svg.title: You.com: search and page reads, plus cited research
svg.desc: The model calls tools from two capabilities. YouSearch adds web_search, which returns the top ten hits with excerpts, and get_page, which returns one page as markdown capped at 10,000 characters. YouResearch adds answer, research and finance_research, which return cited answers. Each tool calls one method of the You.com API. Every tool returns a ToolReturn: the text goes to the model and the sources entry of its metadata holds YouSource records for your app. Authentication, billing and permission errors stop the run; other failures come back as a retry.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
